name: curved_probe_shell
notes: Curved-element probe: a niobium toroidal box shell, 5 mm wall, inner corner radius 0.5 mm, at 20 mm / 8 mm mesh size, so the order-2 geometry of the fillets is under-resolved (size floor 2 mm). Used by benchmarks/curved_elements_study.py and tests/test_mesh3d_curved_elements.py.
